versions.content: If for a dataElement to be received a ReceiverComSpec with handleOutOfRange = ignore is provided, a range check shall be implemented in the receiving component. If the value is out of bounds, the reception of the dataElement shall not be propagated. This means for a non-queued communication that the last valid value will be propagated and for a queued communication that no value will be enqueued. If the value of the received dataElement is out of bounds and a Nonqueue- dReceiverComSpec with handleOutOfRangeStatus = indicate is provided, the return value of the RTE shall be RTE_E_OUT_OF_RANGE . In case of a composite datatype the reception of the whole dataElement shall not be propagated, if any of the composite elements is out of bounds. If the handleOut- OfRangeStatus attribute is set to indicate , the return value of the RTE shall be RTE_E_OUT_OF_RANGE .
